text: Clang lowers progressively, interleaved with its Sema, and without its code generator the IR was missing functionality; attaching clang::CodeGenerator keeps parity with Clang. Rejected: a background thread running the FrontendAction (PR #5543, too complex), the status quo with an ASTConsumer recording what lowering needs (would miss features), and an upstream Clang change (slow) (proposals/p006641-clang-irgen-in-carbon.md).
